reconstructed_captions.4: The soldier reaches the top of the ladder, nearing the ship's main deck.
reconstructed_captions.5: He begins to pull himself over the railing and onto the deck of the ship.
reconstructed_captions.6: The soldier maneuvers his body and gear over the ship's railing.
reconstructed_captions.7: Now safely on the deck, he quickly gets to his feet, weapon ready.
reconstructed_captions.8: He takes a knee to provide cover as a second soldier appears at the top of the ladder.
reconstructed_captions.9: The second soldier climbs over the railing onto the deck of the Frank Cable.
reconstructed_captions.10: He joins the first soldier, and they take up a defensive position together.
reconstructed_captions.11: A third soldier is seen climbing over the railing to join the team on deck.
reconstructed_captions.12: The three soldiers are now grouped together on the deck with their weapons ready.
reconstructed_captions.13: The team leader gives a hand signal to the other two soldiers to advance.
reconstructed_captions.14: The soldiers prepare to move forward from their initial boarding point on the deck.
reconstructed_captions.15: The team begins to move in formation across the ship's deck with purpose.
